apiKeys.heading: API keys
apiKeys.subtitle: Keys that let other systems call the panel's API without a signed-in person.
apiKeys.emptyDescription: Create a key to let another system use the panel's API.
apiKeys.noResultsDescription: Change the search or the filter, or clear them to see every key.
apiKeys.confirmRevoke: The key stops working at once and cannot be restored. Anything that uses it will be refused.

hints.scopes: The key can do only what the ticked scopes allow.
hints.cidrs: One range per line, such as 203.0.113.0/24. Leave empty to allow any address.
hints.expires: Leave empty for a key that never expires.

errors.nameRequired: Enter a name for the key.
errors.cidrInvalid: Each line must be an address range such as 203.0.113.0/24.
errors.expiryPast: Choose a day in the future.

secret.title: Your new API key
secret.warning: Copy this key now. It is shown only once and cannot be shown again.
secret.hint: If you lose the key, revoke it and create a new one.
